subject: Conflux + Redwood: LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK integration & tracing
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@conflux.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@conflux.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Conflux + Redwood: SDK integration (LangChain/LlamaIndex + tracing)

Hi Vanessa —

Quick intro: I lead integrations for Conflux (we build a dev-first agent orchestration platform). We're evaluating Redwood for a joint SDK bundle so Conflux customers can drop-in a LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter with built-in Redwood tracing and token-level telemetry.

High level asks from our side:
- A runtime adapter for LangChain (preferred) and an optional LlamaIndex shim for customers who use index pipelines.
- Tracing hooks that capture prompt-level latency, token counts, and model variant fallback events.
- Guidance on batching/quantization tradeoffs for inference cost at 1k-10k QPS per customer (pilot shape).

Can we set a 30-min tech sync next week to scope a small prototype? I attached our API surface and example LangChain adapter code for context.

Thanks —
Alyssa Chen
Head of Integrations, Conflux
alyssa@conflux.ai
[Attachment: conflux_api_specs.zip (zip)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@conflux.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conflux + Redwood: SDK integration (LangChain/LlamaIndex + tracing)

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the intro and for sending the adapter snippets. This is squarely in our ISV partner program lane and I'm excited to explore a joint offering. 30 minutes next week works — how does Tue May 18 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET look?

A few quick questions to help us prep:
- Do you expect this to be a runtime adapter (calls Redwood at inference time) or an off-host index-sidecar for LlamaIndex customers? Runtime adapter is easier from our side but we want to confirm the desired UX.
- Any target sampling rate for tracing (e.g., all requests for pilot vs 1-10% in production)?
- Expected traffic profile for an initial pilot customer (requests/sec, avg tokens per request, typical sequence lengths).

I've started a short working doc for the sync and proposed a mutual action plan. Can you add a line or two about pilot success criteria?

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Conflux-MAP

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

On Fri, May 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa@conflux.ai> wrote:
> Quick intro: I lead integrations for Conflux...

Thanks Alyssa — copying a brief proposed mutual action plan so we have a shared starting point:

Mutual Action Plan (proposed)
- Discovery (this week): confirm runtime vs sidecar, traffic shape, auth surface.
- Prototype (2 wks): LangChain runtime adapter + Redwood tracing tags (prompt_id, prompt_latency_ms, token_in/out).
- Integration test (1 wk): end-to-end with one pilot customer on staging (integration smoke, sampling at 10%).
- Performance benchmark (1 wk): latency/p95, cost per 1k tokens, token attribution tests.
- Commercial SOW & legal (2 wks): sign SOW; define revenue share for marketplace listing.

Open items we need from Conflux prior to sync:
- Pilot traffic estimate (RPS, average tokens per call).
- Security checklist: do you require SOC2 artifacts, retention controls, or an on-prem/private route for pilot data?
- Any constraints on sampling or PII redaction in traces?

I've added the items above to the Google Doc and dropped in a SOW template for us to iterate on.

Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Reference: conflux_api_specs.zip attached above]

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@conflux.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@conflux.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conflux + Redwood: SDK integration (LangChain/LlamaIndex + tracing)

Thanks Vanessa and Marissa —

We confirmed internally on scope:
- Primary path: LangChain runtime adapter (our customers want drop-in runtime calls). LlamaIndex shim is lower priority but we can scope it in a follow-up.
- Pilot traffic: one customer with expected 600 RPS peak, average 650 tokens per request (embedding and completion mix).
- Tracing: pilot sampling target = 10% (we want prompt-level latency and token_in/out). We also need an event for 'fallback_to_smaller_model' when Redwood routes to cheaper model variants.
- Security: Conflux is SOC2 Type II; we will share the SOC2 report through a secure portal. For pilot, retention of traces should be 30 days.

Attached: draft SOW (conflux_sow_draft.pdf). Please review the commercial terms (we propose co-marketing and a 70/30 revenue split for marketplace lead flows).

Questions for Redwood team:
1) Can Redwood emit tracing tags for prompt_id, token_count, model_variant, and fallback_reason?
2) Can we configure sampling by route and by account (sampling override per-customer)?

DocuSign link for SOW (draft): https://docusign.com/link/CFX-SOW-DRAFT

Appreciate the quick turn. Jordan (cc) will be on the tech sync.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Integrations, Conflux
alyssa@conflux.ai
[Attachment: conflux_sow_draft.pdf (pdf)]

Link to working doc & action tracker: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Conflux-MAP

Thanks all — looking forward.
